title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Gravity in Your Hands

lines.l: As if the night listens only to you
Caught in the quiet gravity you carry
And all I feel is your orbit
You hold the gravity in your hands
Holding me close without a word
The world bends around our steps Soft, weightless, beautifully blurred
Keep me in this drifting light I don't wanna lend to the sun
Keep me in this drifting light I don't wanna lend to the sun
Your breath mixes with the rhythm
Warm against the cold of the speakers
